# Create a new workplane
r = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Define the sketch for the top face
r = r.moveTo(0.0, 0.0043) \
     .threePointArc((0.0013, 0.0013), (0.0043, 0.0)) \
     .lineTo(0.0259, 0.0) \
     .threePointArc((0.0289, 0.0013), (0.0302, 0.0043)) \
     .lineTo(0.0302, 0.0259) \
     .threePointArc((0.0289, 0.0289), (0.0259, 0.0302)) \
     .lineTo(0.0043, 0.0302) \
     .threePointArc((0.0013, 0.0289), (0.0, 0.0259)) \
     .lineTo(0.0, 0.0043) \
     .close()

# Extrude the sketch to create the body
